Question Choices: Select. In constructions, what does the compass draw? ~~Parallel line pairs only | Arcs and circles | Straight lines only~~
Hints: It pivots around a fixed point.|It keeps a constant radius.
Solution: A compass keeps a fixed distance from its center as it turns. A complete turn draws a circle; part of a turn draws an arc.

Question Choices: Select. In constructions, what does the straightedge draw? ~~Circles and arcs | Curves of any shape | Straight lines and segments~~
Hints: It has no markings.|It cannot measure.
Solution: An unmarked straightedge draws straight lines, rays and segments through chosen points. Its classical construction role is drawing straight paths, not measuring lengths.

Question Choices: Select. A point lies on the internal bisector of an angle between 0 and 180 degrees. It is equidistant from which parts of the angle? ~~The vertex and one side | Any two points on the sides | The two sides of the angle~~
Question Answers: The two sides of the angle
Hints: Use the defining property of the bisector.|Compare perpendicular distances to each side.
Solution: It is equally far from the two sides (rays) of the angle, using perpendicular distances. The perpendiculars and the segment to the vertex form right triangles with a common hypotenuse and equal angles at the vertex, so their perpendicular legs match.

Question Choices: Select. To bisect segment AB with a compass, arcs of equal radius are drawn from A and B. The radius must be larger than what? ~~Twice the length of AB | Half the length of AB | The full length of AB~~
Hints: The arcs must intersect above and below the segment.|Too small a radius gives no intersection.
Solution: The common radius must exceed half of AB so that the two equal-radius circles intersect at two points on opposite sides of AB. Equality gives only one touching point; a smaller radius gives no intersection.

Question Choices: A constructed perpendicular bisector of AB meets AB at what angle? Enter only the angle measure in degrees.
Hints: Perpendicular means a right angle.|Bisector also implies the midpoint.
Solution: The constructed line is perpendicular to AB, so it meets AB at a right angle, 90 degrees. It also passes through the midpoint because it bisects the segment.
